'''Software''' — documentation for non-FOSS programs, one page per program. Facts live in the [[Item:|items]]; pages read them at view time. Free &amp; open-source software has its own hub: '''[[FOSS:Main]]'''.
</div>

== Adding software ==

Use '''[[Special:AddSoftware]]''' (search Wikidata or GitHub, or the manual path <code>Special:AddSoftware/manual</code>). The form's '''Page kind''' radio decides where the page lands: a free/open-source license defaults to the <code>FOSS:</code> namespace, anything else to the <code>Software:</code> namespace — you can override it per create. The item's class follows the page kind (<code>free and open-source software</code> for FOSS: pages, <code>software</code> for Software: pages).

Every software page is built from '''[[Template:FOSS]]''' or '''[[Template:Software]]''' (banner + infobox) — see [[Help:Contributing/semanticDynamicContent]] for how the infobox reads the item.
